brief:
Israeli restrictions on building materials are leaving some 2 million displaced Palestinians in Gaza living in deteriorating tents, makeshift shelters, and damaged buildings that offer no protection from the elements, the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported. As winter weather and successive storms hit the Strip, conditions are intensifying and threatening residents' lives, the organization said.

The restrictions compound an existing humanitarian crisis that has forced Palestinians into inadequate housing with minimal safety standards. The situation is expected to worsen as cold weather persists across the territory.

title: Israel restricts shelter materials for displaced Gazans facing winter
